component: Ensrick Vikings Weaponry SE Mesh Port
mo2OverlayMod: Ensrick - Vikings Weaponry SE Mesh Port
purpose: Convert the six Vikings Weaponry meshes, shipped inside the mod's BSA at NIF stream 83 despite the SE listing, to SSE stream 100 / BSTriShape with rescaled Havok collision.

source.author: johnskyrim
source.inputForm: entries inside 'Vikings Weaponry - Johnskyrim.bsa' in the installed vendor mod (extract with audit/modasset.py BSA or any BSA tool)

tool.commitNote: convert-sse code path is unchanged from 1cc5484 (origin/main) through e12079c and c63f74e; the port was made before c63f74e was committed and the exact binary is not hash-matched to a commit, so the pinned commit is the pushed head that contains the identical verb.

transformation.command: extract each BSA entry to a temp file, then nif-port-cli.exe convert-sse "<temp>/<name>.nif" "<output root>/meshes/johnskyrim/lothbrok"
